retrievalProfile.description: High-glamour studio portraiture featuring platinum blonde hair, oversized geometric eyewear, and a cool-toned gradient background with metallic gold typography.
excludeWhen: gritty or lo-fi textures are requested
minimalist or flat design is the goal

recipe.visualDefinition: A polished, high-contrast studio portrait of a woman with sleek platinum blonde hair and bangs, wearing large geometric sunglasses. The lighting is bright and directional, creating a soft glow on the skin and hair against a cool blue-grey gradient background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's platinum hair contrasts against the cool blue background
Warm gold jewelry and typography balance the cool-toned environment
Geometric lines of the sunglasses echo the sharp edges of the hair styling
High-key lighting emphasizes the smooth, retouched texture of the skin
coreInvariants: Platinum blonde hair with straight-cut bangs
Cool-toned blue or grey gradient background
High-gloss red or coral lip color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait, subject centered but angled slightly to the side, filling most of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and oversized sunglasses serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright hair to the sunglasses, down to the lips, and then to the gold jewelry and text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the upper corners around the head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Platinum white and cool blue-grey (background and hair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) with low saturation in the background, contrasted by high saturation in the lips and metallic gold.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool blues, whites, and metallic golds

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a wide, geometric sans-serif with thin strokes
Secondary text uses a fluid, slanted formal script
Letters feature metallic gold gradients and thin black outlines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'f' and 't' in the script are elongated to create horizontal flourishes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a modern, wide geometric sans and a traditional, fluid script.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory sticker in bottom left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric sans-serif structure of the primary text.
Provides the elegant, slanted script contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a woman with platinum blonde hair and bangs, wearing oversized gold-rimmed aviator sunglasses and a gold necklace, against a cool blue-grey gradient background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add wide geometric sans-serif text in gold with a thin black outline at the top, paired with a black slanted script subtitle slightly overlapping it.

verificationChecks: Is the hair platinum blonde with straight bangs?
Are the sunglasses oversized and geometric?
Is the background a cool-toned gradient?
Is the typography a mix of gold sans-serif and black script?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific brand logos on the jewelry
Ensure the script text is legible despite the overlap

mustAchieve: Crisp metallic textures on gold elements

postGenerationChecks: Check for metallic sheen on gold elements
Verify the high-key lighting doesn't blow out hair detail
Ensure the script font feels fluid and calligraphic
Confirm the color balance between cool background and warm accents
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Platinum Blonde + Geometric Eyewear + Cool Gradient + Gold/Script Typography
